question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Obsession
solution:
The correct answer is "**Dislike**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Antonym means a word that has the opposite meaning of the asked word.
 
• Now, let us understand the meaning off the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **Obsession means an intense and persistent fixation on something**.(जुनून)
 
 
• ​Example: She had an obsession of flowers.
 
 
 
• **Dislike means a feeling of not liking or approving of something.**(नफ़रत)
 
 
• ​Example: She disliked those flowers.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, Dislike is the most appropriate antonym of obsession as it represents the opposite meaning of fixation and persistence.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Delusion means a false belief or opinion about something.(माया)
 
• Compulsion means an irresistible urge to do something.(बाध्यता)
 
• Relaxation means the state of being free from tension and anxiety.(विश्राम)
